reviewer: Codex, direct visual inspection in this run
method: Each built-in output inspected on return, including all three corrected candidates. All 23 finished PNGs inspected on three large card sheets and one wide sheet; both card categories also inspected at 180px height.

textReview.method: Direct visual review; no OCR claim.

knownWeaknesses: At 180px card height the visitor badge, individual accounting rules, exact folder count and toner details are small; prefer 256x358 or larger for focused cards.
The four server digits illustrate collaboration and must not be read as the seeded gameplay code.
Closure art is intentionally dimmer; confirm contrast in the final Unity layout.
